how: Hong Kong crags such as Tung Lung Chau and Lantau's Temple Crag offer multi-pitch trad and sport routes up to roughly 70 m, but there are no true big walls.
Weekly drop-in capoeira classes run in Quarry Bay and at BeWater in Tsim Sha Tsui, alongside the Capoeira Federation of Hong Kong.
venue: Quarry Bay Capoeira / BeWater Martial Arts & Wellness

how: Recreational hunting is not available: wild animals are protected by ordinance and there is no licensed sport-hunting scene; the nearest hunting is on the mainland.

Hong Kong FPV Racers, founded in 2015, organises FPV and nano drone racing; the Hong Kong Drone Sports Association ran an FAI-sanctioned open in 2019, and races need Civil Aviation Department permission.
Reservoir angling is permitted at Plover Cove and other reservoirs from September to March with a Water Supplies Department licence.
Geocaching has been active since the first cache in Lung Fu Shan Country Park in 2002, with caches in parks, hiking trails and urban areas.
venue: Lung Fu Shan Country Park caches

how: The Hong Kong Bird Watching Society runs raptor identification workshops and Mai Po tours targeting eagles, and migration season draws raptors over the territory.
venue: Hong Kong Bird Watching Society / Mai Po Nature Reserve

how: K-FARM in Sheung Shui runs urban farming workshops covering hydroponics, aquaponics and organic rooftop farming.
Guided foraging walks for edible and medicinal wild plants in the countryside have been led by local guides such as Wanda Huang, though not on a regular schedule.
GO PARK Aqua at Sai Sha offers wakeboarding towed by an electric cable or boat, with full equipment rental.
Angling is possible from piers and reservoirs, and Kau Sai Wan Recreational Fishing Wonderland near Sai Kung offers a boat trip with gear and a crash course.
venue: Kau Sai Wan Recreational Fishing Wonderland

how: Guided SUP and kayak tours of the Ting Kok mangroves in Tai Po are run by operators such as Holimood, and GO PARK Sai Sha schedules mangrove kayaking sessions.
Hong Kong has no regular balloon operation; the AIA International Hot Air Balloon Festival at the Central Harbourfront held tethered rides in September 2025 as a one-off event.
venue: AIA International Hot Air Balloon Festival

how: Hebe Haven Yacht Club runs Hong Kong Sailing Federation-accredited keelboat courses on J/80 keelboats, open to non-members aged 16 and over.
Kite flying is allowed at designated spots such as Tai Po Waterfront Park, Tai Hang Tun, Tap Mun and Shek O Beach, subject to Civil Aviation Department height rules.
venue: Tai Po Waterfront Park / Shek O Beach

how: Kau Sai Wan Recreational Fishing Wonderland is a stocked fish-farm site near Sai Kung offering a full-day package with boat transfer and gear.
venue: Kau Sai Wan Recreational Fishing Wonderland

how: AQUALAND in Sai Kung runs SUP yoga sessions with professional coaches, and Holimood also lists SUP yoga.
Groundswell at AIRSIDE in Kai Tak has a FlowRider standing-wave machine and a beginner surf school.
Aeria Studio (Kennedy Town and Sheung Wan) and Pegasus Studio in Wan Chai teach aerial silks, hoop, trapeze and acrobatics to adults with no experience needed.
Pipe Band Hong Kong, formed in 1982, is the largest civilian pipe and drum band in the city, and the Hong Kong Police Pipe Band is a full-time professional band.

Community Chinese orchestras exist, but many such as the Police Chinese Culture Club orchestra restrict membership, and the Music Office's Hong Kong Youth Chinese Orchestra takes only people under 25.
Hong Kong City Choir is a non-professional choir founded in 1999 with over 80 members.
Fine Music centres in Yuen Long, Sha Tin, Fanling and Tuen Mun offer one-to-one beginner erhu lessons.

how: Aspire Music in Wan Chai and Parsons Music Academy (about 20 branches) teach guitar to adults and children.
HeartStrings Centre teaches harp and lyre from preschool to adult pop-harp courses.
O'Connor-Barton Irish Dance holds year-round classes at several Hong Kong locations for ages 3 and up.
Parsons Music Academy, Aspire Music and Fine Music all teach piano to beginners, adults and children.
Grappa's Cellar in Central hosts a weekly swing night with a beginners' class before social dancing, and the annual Hong Kong Swing Festival offers workshops.
GEKKO, a taiko ensemble founded in Hong Kong in 2006, performs and competes, including at Japan's Katsugi Oke Battle in 2019.
The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts has offered public tap classes since 1994, and Island Dance teaches ISTD tap at many venues.
venue: Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts

how: Batik workshops run occasionally at PMQ, Asia Society Hong Kong and other venues rather than as regular classes.
Art Connect and Communication in Kwun Tong runs English-language brush calligraphy and ink painting classes, and the Hong Kong Palace Museum has held adult masterclasses.

how: KA Atelier in Wan Chai teaches Chinese painting to adults, and Art Connect in Kwun Tong offers ink painting classes in English.
HKAS runs a one-day black-and-white film developing and enlarger printing workshop, and Camera Film Photo in Cheung Sha Wan hosts darkroom printing workshops.
Astro Heart Film Academy and VTC offer part-time film production and compositing courses for adults.
Short courses in 2D animation are offered for adults, such as the HKMU/HKAGE programme and CityU's 2D Animation I.
Make and Do Hong Kong in Chai Wan and Senseless Art Studio in Prince Edward run beginner hand-embroidery workshops.
The Hong Kong Design Institute (VTC) runs a one-day Level 1 glass lampworking workshop, and Some Thingsss teaches lampworking.
Weekly open life-drawing sessions run on Tuesday evenings at senselessart Studio in Mong Kok, with short poses suited to beginners.
Make and Do Hong Kong ran a beginner macrame plant-hanger class in Chai Wan, and PMQ has included macrame in its workshop series.
Studio 83 teaches classical oil and acrylic painting and Hong Kong Art Tutoring in North Point offers adult courses.
Origami is taught in occasional workshops, such as Asia Society Hong Kong's family sessions with a Japanese instructor.
